items.title: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full models for agentic tasks
items.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it describes as its most capable models so far, built for personal and professional agentic tasks. Muse Wonder is available to developers through the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. Meta says Muse Wonder will later power the consumer Muse app, starting with subscribers. It also describes memory across conversations, a feature for persisting on multi-step work, and training to avoid sharing private information without permission. A fuller safety evaluation report is promised but not yet published.

items.title: Meta previews open data center networking hardware at OCP Global Summit 2026
items.summary_en: Engineering at Meta described new networking hardware for AI data centers, including its first liquid-cooled network rack (IcePack), a 102.4T switch platform (IceCube), and an open-source RDMA transport protocol (MetaRoCE). The post is framed around scale-up, scale-out and scale-across networks.

items.title: Meta, Pinacoteca di Brera and EssilorLuxottica pilot AI glasses for art access
items.summary_en: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launched a pilot at Milan's Pinacoteca di Brera museum. It uses AI glasses to make art more accessible to blind and low-vision visitors.

items.title: Meta donates 1,000 AI glasses to Singapore disability organizations
items.summary_en: Meta announced a donation of 1,000 Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses to four disability organizations in Singapore.
